Partner-Facing Structure

Mojo AI Summits Partner Pricing Structure

Executive access is structured as a stackable subscription per Executive slot. Each subscription buys one Executive slot, which may be assigned to one approved director-level-or-above Executive attendee at a time according to the substitution rules in the partner agreement.

View Partner Tiers View Candidate Pricing View Have a Taste Program
Per Executive Slot

One subscribed slot admits one approved Executive attendee at a time.

Annual Contract

The purchase price may be paid quarterly during the annual term.

Director Level or Above

Each approved Executive attendee must meet the director-level threshold.

Positioning Principle

What the Partnership Buys

Mojo AI Summits does not sell booths, badge scans, or generic logo packages. Your organization subscribes Executive slots into a curated executive intelligence network with access to approved Mojo virtual events, summits, and specialty events according to each subscription tier.

Trusted proximity, not lead capture

Mojo creates access to serious executive rooms where trust, relevance, and repeated participation matter more than badge scans.

Executive contribution, not vendor theater

Your role is to improve the quality of the conversation instead of turning the room into a sales presentation.

Relationship intelligence, not attendee lists

Mojo focuses on context, shared participation history, appropriate follow-up paths, and consent-aware relationship development.

Annual partnership, not one-off event spend

The value compounds across virtual events, summits, specialty events, and ongoing executive intelligence.

Curated participation, not open sponsorship inventory

Mojo protects the executive room by matching partner participation to credibility, topic fit, and contribution value.

Partner Candidate

Candidate Pricing

Partner Candidate is the pre-approval qualification stage. Partner Candidate means your organization is not yet an approved Partner. Candidate pricing applies while your organization remains in Candidate status, and Partner discounts are not available until your organization is approved as a Partner.

Candidate Access Level Candidate Price Billing Basis Access
Tier 2(Intelligence Partner) $650 per quarter Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance
Tier 2 and Tier 3(Summit Partner) $3,250 per quarter Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance plus summit attendance
Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4(Strategic Partner) $13,000 per quarter Per quarter, annual subscription Unlimited virtual event attendance, summit attendance, and eligible Mojo events above and beyond Tier 2 and Tier 3

Candidate pricing is applied to each subscribed Executive slot while your organization remains in Candidate status. Partner discounts do not apply during the Candidate period.

New Partner Candidates

Have a Taste Program

Have a Taste is a first-quarter introduction for brand-new Partner Candidates. If your organization is new to Mojo AI Summits, you may qualify to use standard Partner subscription pricing for your first quarter as a Partner Candidate.

The program is designed to let your team experience the quality of the room, the executive contribution model, and Mojo relationship intelligence during an introductory quarter. If your organization does not become an approved Partner before the next quarter begins, pricing moves to the regular Candidate pricing structure.

Access Level Have a Taste First-Quarter Price Applies To Access
Tier 2(Intelligence Partner) $500 First Candidate quarter only One Executive slot with Tier 2 access for one quarter
Tier 2 and Tier 3(Summit Partner) $2,500 First Candidate quarter only One Executive slot with Tier 2 and Tier 3 access for one quarter
Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4(Strategic Partner) $10,000 First Candidate quarter only One Executive slot with Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 access for one quarter

Have a Taste does not create Partner approval or permanent Partner pricing by itself. After the first quarter, continued participation moves to Candidate pricing unless your organization is approved as a Partner.

Each Have a Taste slot is still one Executive slot. The Executive attendee using the slot must be director level or above.

Subscription Ladder

Partner Tier Pricing

Each Executive slot must be subscribed individually. One subscribed Executive slot admits one approved Executive attendee at a time. Approved Executive attendees must be director level or above.

Partner Page Tier Subscription Function Price Per Executive Slot Billing Basis Access
Tier 1(Partner) Approved partner status Included in partner approval N/A Establishes partner eligibility and profile
Tier 2(Intelligence Partner) Virtual event subscription $500 Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance
Tier 2 and Tier 3(Summit Partner) Summit attendance subscription $2,500 total Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance plus Mojo summit attendance
Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4(Strategic Partner) Full Mojo event subscription $10,000 total Per quarter, annual subscription Unlimited virtual event attendance, summit attendance, and eligible Mojo events above and beyond Tier 2 and Tier 3
Payment Terms

Annual Contract, Quarterly Payments

Partner subscriptions are annual contracts. The purchase price may be paid quarterly during the annual contract term. Quarterly payment does not convert the subscription into a quarter-to-quarter commitment.

If you pay the annual subscription in full at the start of the contract term, you receive a 10% annual payment discount.

Payment Option Discount Pricing Treatment
Quarterly payments 0% Standard annual contract price paid quarterly
Annual payment upfront 10% 10% discount for paying the annual subscription in full at the start of the term

Discounts

Executive Slot and Executive Member Status Discounts

Discounts are applied per Executive slot. Your agreement will show the active subscription tier, slot-count discount, and member-status discount for each subscribed Executive slot.

Partner discounts are available only after your organization is approved as a Partner. Partner Candidates do not receive Partner discounts during the Candidate period.

Executive Slot Discounts

Executive Slot Discount Pricing Treatment
First Executive slot 0% Standard subscription price
Second Executive slot 15% 15% discount on that slot's subscription fee
Third Executive slot and beyond 30% 30% discount on each additional slot's subscription fee

Executive Member Status Discounts

Executive Member Status Discount Pricing Treatment
Tier 3 member 10% 10% discount for that Executive slot
Tier 4 member 20% 20% discount for that Executive slot
SMB Program

Qualified SMB Vendors

Vendors with a market cap below $1 million may qualify for the SMB program. Qualified SMB vendors pay 50% of the applicable Partner subscription price for each subscribed Executive slot.

Access Level Standard Quarterly Cost SMB Quarterly Cost What It Covers
Tier 2 only $500 $250 Unlimited virtual event attendance
Tier 2 + Tier 3 $2,500 $1,250 Unlimited virtual event attendance plus summit attendance
Tier 2 + Tier 3 + Tier 4 $10,000 $5,000 Unlimited virtual event attendance, summit attendance, and eligible Mojo events beyond Tier 2 and Tier 3

If your organization is both a Partner Candidate and an SMB-qualified vendor, your agreement will specify whether Candidate pricing or SMB program pricing applies during the qualification period.

Tier Details

Partner Page Tiers

Tier 1: Partner

Approved organization status

Partner establishes that your company is qualified for the Mojo AI Summits partner network.

  • Formal Partner designation
  • Partner profile setup
  • Partner company relationship record
  • Approved partner contacts attached to the company record
  • Eligibility to subscribe Executive slots into Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4

Tier 2: Intelligence Partner

$500 per quarter per Executive slot

Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance for the Executive attendee using your subscribed slot during the active subscription period.

  • Virtual event access for one approved Executive attendee using the subscribed slot
  • Participation in approved online executive sessions
  • Access to recurring Mojo virtual programming
  • Mojo relationship tracking for participation through the Executive slot

Tier 3: Summit Partner

$2,500 total per quarter per Executive slot

Mojo summit attendance for the Executive attendee using your subscribed slot during the active subscription period.

  • Summit attendance access for one approved Executive attendee using the subscribed slot
  • Participation in approved summit programming
  • Mojo relationship tracking for summit participation
  • Eligibility to purchase Tier 4 Strategic Partner access

Tier 4: Strategic Partner

$10,000 total per quarter per Executive slot

Unlimited eligible Mojo event attendance above and beyond Tier 2 virtual events and Tier 3 summit events, under an annual subscription commitment.

  • Access to eligible Mojo specialty events, partner events, executive experiences, and additional approved event formats
  • Priority consideration for strategic partner programming
  • Mojo relationship tracking for broader Mojo event participation
  • Strategic relationship visibility across the subscribed Executive slot's participation history

Agreement Details

What the Partner Agreement Specifies

  • Partner company name
  • Partner or Partner Candidate status
  • SMB program eligibility, when applicable
  • Have a Taste eligibility and introductory quarter, when applicable
  • Number of Executive slots
  • Approved Executive attendee assignment for each slot
  • Confirmation that each approved Executive attendee is director level or above
  • Subscription tier for each Executive slot
  • Candidate pricing, when applicable
  • Partner discount eligibility, when applicable
  • Slot-count discount for each eligible Executive slot
  • Member-status discount for each eligible Executive slot
  • Start date and renewal date
  • Quarterly billing terms for Tier 2 and Tier 3
  • Quarterly billing terms for Tier 4 under the annual subscription
  • Annual contract term with quarterly payment schedule, when selected
  • Annual payment discount, when selected
  • Event categories included and excluded
  • Substitution rules for Executive slot assignments
  • Conduct and trust standards
  • Data sharing and relationship visibility rules

Mojo AI Summits uses a per-Executive slot subscription model. Tier 2 is $500 per quarter for unlimited virtual event attendance. Tier 3 is $2,500 per quarter for virtual event access plus summit attendance. Tier 4 is $10,000 per quarter under an annual subscription for virtual events, summit attendance, and eligible Mojo events above and beyond Tier 2 and Tier 3. Partner Candidate means your organization is not yet an approved Partner, so Partner discounts do not apply until approval. Brand-new Partner Candidates may qualify for Have a Taste, a first-quarter introduction using standard Partner subscription pricing. If your organization does not become an approved Partner before the next quarter, pricing moves to the regular Candidate pricing structure.
